sn45.55:0.3: Accomplishment in Rational Application of Mind (1st)
sn45.55:1.1: “Meditators, the dawn is the forerunner and harbinger of the sunrise.
sn45.55:1.2: In the same way accomplishment in wise attention is the forerunner and harbinger of the noble eightfold path for a meditator.
sn45.55:1.3: A meditator accomplished in wise attention can expect to develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path.
sn45.55:1.4: And how does a meditator accomplished in wise attention develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path?
sn45.55:1.5: It’s when a meditator develops right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration, which rely on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripen as letting go.
sn45.55:1.6: That’s how a meditator accomplished in wise attention develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path.”
